locks: Complete roster: 16 adults, 1 standing child, 1 toddler seated in a stroller; 18 people.
Single row; front-view full-body framing; common shoe/wheel baseline; no scale silhouette or lettering.
Yang: 63, thin, bald with grey fringe, round glasses, brown cardigan, grey shirt, Association star-and-shield.
Three distinct older aunties: tall/thin with sun visor; round with floral headscarf; tiny with gold necklace. Rubber aprons, boots, arm sleeves.
Old fisherman: sixties, grey stubble, navy knit cap, orange waterproofs; distinct younger fisherman.
PC bang owner: sleepy man in his thirties in hoodie, unlit cigarette behind ear, broom held with bristles on ground.
PR pair: navy blazers with SILVER HEXAGON emblems; man holds blank glossy folder. Photographer holds large camera on strap.
Evacuee family: fishmonger father, mother with toddler's stroller, separate standing child; children covered and drawn simply.
Engineer: grey coveralls, white hard hat, neck respirator, orange life vest over usual kit.
Trooper: black tactical armour, smoky full-helmet visor, silver corporate hexagon, orange life vest over armour, secured gear.

PC owner's unlit cigarette is not clearly legible.
Mother's lower legs are partly occluded by stroller.
PR pins are silver but their tiny geometry is simplified; elderly aunties' head/body ratios merit review at source size.
